items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: And the last conversation I had with him I ended it with, “Pete I can’t play fast anymore man.”

ctx.x: Hey one thing, if I don’t say hello from Pete Procopio I’m going to be —
Oh man, yeah you too, please say hello to him for me.
